t: Why do people still buy Thrustmaster? : r/simracing

I read about people removing the hub adaptor top put onto other wheels, but really, it is best to use 1 adaptor for 1 wheel, and buy extra if needed. Thrustmaster have been in the game since before I had my 486 pc years ago.
